VBO:0200315.summary: Inquisitive and affectionate with his own people, adult Cavapom Minton gives a personal glimpse of this Cavalier King Charles Spaniel–Pomeranian cross. His owners describe training with boundaries and cheese, and a dog who enjoyed football in the snow while avoiding swimming. They also recall him communicating with his nose and barks during a long life together.
VBO:0200315.shortDescription: A Cavalier–Pomeranian cross; adult Minton was affectionate with his people, playful in snow and vocal in communication.
